data.name: Scope
data.value: The score covers the checks performed. Check limitations are listed below. Traffic analysis and upgrade recommendations are planned for later stages.

data.name: ConsentHint
data.value: This check requires consent to external connectivity tests.

data.name: AdminHint
data.value: Run collection with administrator rights for this check.

data.name: CheckHint
data.value: Review the module status and limitations in technical details.

data.name: ChartScope
data.value: Missing data does not mean zero latency or no events. Each chart has its own scale; event timestamps are a sample, not the complete log. Connectivity measurements refer to the indicated interface and may reflect a tunnel response.

data.name: EventTimeline
data.value: Network event timestamps by UTC day (sample)

data.name: CollectionModeLimited
data.value: Collected without administrator rights — some data is unavailable

data.name: CollectionModeUnknown
data.value: Collection permissions are unknown: the snapshot has no elevation flag

data.name: ExUnknownMechanism
data.value: There is not enough known data to explain the setting's effect.

data.name: ExNoSymptom
data.value: An application failure has not been established by this data.

data.name: ExInspect
data.value: Identify the affected application and preserve the snapshot for comparison.

data.name: ExIncomplete
data.value: There is insufficient data for this claim.

data.name: ExTime
data.value: Modules were collected sequentially. State may have changed between checks; exact times of individual tests are not established here.

data.name: ExContextMissing
data.value: The fact context for this analysis is unavailable; the main report is preserved.

data.name: ExBuildFailed
data.value: The explanation could not be built. This does not indicate normal operation; the main report is preserved.

data.name: ExOverlapTitle
data.value: The table contains overlapping routes through two VPNs

data.name: ExBroadScope
data.value: Broad routes of one address family; not every application connection

data.name: ExOverlapMechanism
data.value: Overlapping broad routes provide alternative paths for the same addresses. Selection for a specific target is shown separately when known.

data.name: ExOverlapSymptom
data.value: If a resource requires the other VPN's path, it may be unavailable. This does not prove the cause of the reported issue.

data.name: ExOverlapAction
data.value: Identify which VPN the resource needs. Preserve settings and compare the same request with each client separately in an approved test environment. Consult the administrator for a mandatory VPN.

data.name: ExCausality
data.value: The overlap is confirmed; its connection to an application failure is not established.

data.name: ExOverlapClaim
data.value: Broad {2} routes through clients {0} and {1} overlap: {3}.

data.name: ExRouteMechanism
data.value: Routes define possible paths. Local selection for a reference address does not confirm traffic transmission.

data.name: ExVpnAction
data.value: If there are no reported issues, these data do not call for a change. Otherwise identify the application and reproduce the issue.

data.name: ExNotTraffic
data.value: The actual packet path and Internet operation have not been verified.

data.name: ExNoOverlap
data.value: The complete data contain no overlap of the considered broad routes through two proven distinct clients.

data.name: ExVpnIncomplete
data.value: The VPN check is incomplete: not all routes, states or participants are established. Absence of a conflict is not confirmed.

data.name: ExNoAuthorship
data.value: An interface or process participating in a path does not establish who changed the setting.

data.name: ExSelected
data.value: Windows selected interface {1} for reference address {0}.

data.name: ExLocalSelectionScope
data.value: Local route selection without sending a packet

data.name: ExSelectionUnknown
data.value: Successful reference route selection is unknown.

data.name: ExDns
data.value: DNS addresses assigned to interface {0}: {1}. VPN ownership and availability are not established.

data.name: ExDnsScope
data.value: DNS assignment to an interface; not every application's selection

data.name: ExDnsUnknown
data.value: DNS assignment in this scope is not established; known routes are preserved.

data.name: ExProxyScope_user
data.value: Collected account's manual proxy; only requests using it without a matching bypass

data.name: ExProxyScope_machine
data.value: Machine manual proxy under policy; only requests using it without a matching bypass

data.name: ExProxyScope_winhttp
data.value: WinHTTP proxy; only requests using these settings without a matching bypass

data.name: ExProxyMechanism
data.value: A request using this manual setting without a bypass first needs a connection to the configured proxy endpoint.

data.name: ExProxySymptom
data.value: A request using this setting may encounter a proxy error. A specific application failure was not observed.

data.name: ExProxyBoundary
data.value: The conclusion concerns the endpoint and check time, not all applications. TCP does not test the HTTP/SOCKS protocol.

data.name: ExProxyAction
data.value: If the proxy is required, check its serving application or consult the administrator. If no longer required, preserve the original settings before disabling it manually. Then repeat the local check and application request.

data.name: ExProxyApplies
data.value: The manual setting applies in the stated scope, but not necessarily to every application.

data.name: ExProxyDisabled
data.value: This manual setting is not in effect in the stated scope.

data.name: ExProxyScopeUnknown
data.value: The effective proxy scope is unknown or ambiguous (mode, policy or account). The known setting is preserved.

data.name: ExTcp_refused
data.value: The TCP connection to the configured endpoint was refused during the test.

data.name: ExTcp_timeout
data.value: No TCP connection response arrived within the test period. This does not prove that no listener exists.

data.name: ExTcp_open
data.value: A TCP connection was accepted; proxy protocol operation and the application request were not checked.

data.name: ExTcp_error
data.value: The TCP test encountered an error; availability is not established.

data.name: ExTcp_unknown
data.value: Endpoint availability was not checked. External tests require consent for the run.

data.name: ExListenerPresent
data.value: The table contains a matching listener for the address, family and port.

data.name: ExListenerAbsent
data.value: No matching listener for the address, family and port was found in the complete table at collection time.

data.name: ExListenerUnknown
data.value: The presence of a matching listener is unknown; a missing row is not treated as evidence.

data.name: ExOwnerUnknown
data.value: The endpoint's owning application is unknown; the author of the setting is also not established.

data.name: ExListenerOwner
data.value: The matching listener is linked to process {0} (PID {1}); the author of the setting is unknown.

data.name: ExOtherUser
data.value: Collection ran under another account: the owner's proxy settings were not checked.

data.name: ExInterfaceClient
data.value: Interface {0} is linked to client {1}; the author of the route settings is not established.

data.name: ExInterfaceClientUnknown
data.value: The application linked to interface {0} is not unambiguously identified.
